description: Centrais Solares is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Direção-Geral de Energia e Geologia - DGEG. Solar Power Plants of mainland Portugal, licensed or under licensing by the Directorate-General for Energy and Geology. This dataset is part of the High Value/HVD Datasets identified in accordance with Implementing Regulation (EU) 2023/138 of Directive (EU) 2019/1024 on open data and the re-use of public sector information. Coverage: mainland Portugal. The portal shows the English title as "Solar Power Plants" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Direção-Geral de Energia e Geologia - DGEG. Its keywords include energia, ambiente, observacao-da-terra-e-do-ambiente, infofeatureaccessservice, cartografia-oficial, inspirecore. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
